label: Diagram 45
caption: Diagram 45 Large or unusual fireplace openings. (Note: for use with this Appendix, measure L, H and W in mm)
description:
The drawing is a line diagram headed "Diagram 45 Large or unusual fireplace openings." with a note reading "(Note: for use with this Appendix, measure L, H and W in mm)". It contains five separate perspective line drawings, each carrying dimension symbols.

Top left, "Corner opening": two perpendicular wall lines form an angled opening; a vertical double-headed arrow is labelled H and a double-headed arrow along the base is labelled L.

Top right, "Open front and back": a wall opening drawn in perspective, with dashed lines showing the rear; a vertical arrow is labelled H, a diagonal arrow across the opening W, and the text "L = 2 x W" sits beneath.

Centre, "Large opening": a rectangular opening in a perspective wall, with a base arrow L and a vertical arrow H.

Bottom left, "Ingle nook canopy": a recessed form drawn in solid and dashed lines, with a vertical arrow H and a diagonal arrow L.

Bottom right, "Free-standing canopy": a similar dashed-and-solid form, with a vertical arrow H and a diagonal arrow L.
